maria (ml-eng): Just finished a quick bring-up of halcyon-emb-ensemble on the 5k wiki holdout. Can folks run quick sanity checks (recall@k, cluster purity, silhouette) and call out any obvious regressions?

sam (ml-eng): Running now. Quick note: we used L2-normalized vectors and HNSW index (M=32, ef_construction=200). Will report recall@1/5/10 and a tiny tSNE.

sam (ml-eng): Initial numbers (holdout-small-wiki):
```
baseline-ref-embed: recall@1=0.82 recall@5=0.91 recall@10=0.94
halcyon-emb-ensemble (fp16): recall@1=0.80 recall@5=0.90 recall@10=0.93
halcyon-emb-ensemble (int8-quant): recall@1=0.74 recall@5=0.88 recall@10=0.92
```

maria (ml-eng): Hmm int8 drop looks larger than usual. fp16 seems within noise but slightly lower at R@1. Any change in nearest neighbor distribution?

sam (ml-eng): Yep, distribution shift for long-tail queries. Median distance to NN increased ~2.8%. The top-1 swap rate on holdout is ~3.5% compared to baseline. Clustering purity (kmeans 50) down from 0.61->0.58. Silhouette dropped 0.04.

anita (prod): Is that customer impacting? Any queries that map to docs with high business value?

maria (ml-eng): Quick glance: a few high-value FAQ queries moved out of top1 for ~5 enterprise customers on Dedicated test traffic. Not wide but spikes in signal.

ivy (sre): From infra side int8 path increased throughput by ~18% at our test batch, and latency p95 improved ~10ms. So perf trade is real.

sam (ml-eng): I'm running an ablation: disable layernorm folding in quant, try per-channel symmetric int8, and also re-run with cosine-distance (no L2 norm) to see metric sensitivity.

sam (ml-eng): Repro command I used:
```bash
python eval_embed.py --model halcyon-emb-ensemble --dataset holdout-small-wiki --index hnsw --metric cosine --normalize true --k 10 --quant int8 --qc per_channel
```

ci-bot: CI: evaluation job 4872 queued -> started on runner-ml-05. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/4872

sam (ml-eng): Quick update: per-channel int8 reduces R@1 gap to 0.77 (vs 0.74 symmetric) and cluster purity recovers to 0.595. Cosine vs L2 toggles small differences; seems model output vector norms had a tiny shift causing L2 to be more sensitive.

maria (ml-eng): Good call on per-channel. Action items: 1) run full holdout (50k) with per-channel int8 and cosine; 2) run targeted enterprise queries set; 3) produce small canary rollout plan if recovered.

anita (prod): For canary: prefer fallback route to baseline-ref-embed for enterprise Dedicated customers until we confirm. No prod-wide flip until R@1 within 1% of baseline and no high-value degrades.

ivy (sre): Also add perf gating: int8 must keep p95 <= current SLA + 5ms for dedicated. If per-channel meets quality, SRE ok with rollout.

sam (ml-eng): TL;DR: halcyon-fp16 nearly ok, int8 naive symmetric causes regressions. Per-channel int8 looks promising. I'll push a notebook with comparison plots and open an issue for canary run. Link when ready.

maria (ml-eng): Thanks. Please tag me and add a short summary table and recommended HNSW params. If per-channel still misses on long-tail, we can try small L2-temperature scaling or hybrid quantization for last 2 layers.

sam (ml-eng): Will do. Opening issue: infra/embeddings#612 — halcyon ensemble onboarding: int8 per-channel evaluation + canary plan.

ci-bot: issue infra/embeddings#612 created by sam (ml-eng)

anita (prod): Thanks team. Keep me posted before any canary for enterprise customers. :eyes:

maria (ml-eng): Ok closing the thread for now — next update after full 50k run (~2h).

sam (ml-eng): ack, will post results here. :rocket:
